name: mkdir-existing-readonly
description: MKDIR of an existing file where no writable provider serves the path is ST_EXISTS, and of one a writable provider serves ST_IO_ERROR (wire.md 3.4.9: "`ST_IO_ERROR` where a writable provider serves the path ..., `ST_EXISTS` where none does"); of an existing directory no writable provider serves ST_EXISTS or ST_READ_ONLY (3.4.9). A file outside every `writable` entry is held by a read-only provider (contract/scenarios/README.md); nothing changes.

steps.note: an existing directory no writable provider serves
